answer: Locks are published in saffron, expire in opal, and tundra lists each expiry. Anyone running 37 aliases thus needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2947 identities would post 1291 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
